title: Fix the Shower
description: Keep strong delivery through a constrained house-plumbing route while limiting pressure loss and unnecessary material.
hints: A shorter route is not always a better route if it creates a sharp restriction.
Use the pressure view to find where energy is being lost.

showcase.fidelity_note: MVP visualizes simplified 2D incompressible flow through a house-packaging proxy. It does not model fixture demand diversity, elevation head, pipe-network sizing, or code compliance.
